💼 FAU President's Internship Program – Spring 2027 | Apply by Oct 5

Paid, part-time internships at 50+ local nonprofits and government orgs. Great option if you're looking for real-world experience this spring.

💵 $20/hour | ⏰ Up to 20 hrs/week | 📍 On-site (no remote)
📅 Jan 11 – May 5, 2027

─────────────────────────────
✅ Eligibility
─────────────────────────────
- Junior or Senior with 60+ credit hours at FAU
- Good academic standing, actively enrolled
- Must NOT graduate before May 2027
- Undergrads only — master's students & alums are not eligible

─────────────────────────────
📋 How to Apply
─────────────────────────────
1️⃣ Apply + submit resume on Handshake: https://fau.joinhandshake.com/edu/jobs/11284106
2️⃣ Complete the application form and list your top 5 internship choices

⚠️ Both steps are required — incomplete apps won't be considered.

─────────────────────────────
❓ Q&A Sessions
─────────────────────────────
- Sept 16, 11am–12pm → https://fau.joinhandshake.com/edu/events/2010245
- Sept 17, 12–1pm → https://fau.joinhandshake.com/edu/events/2010251

🚨 Job Opportunity — FAU OIT (Act Fast!)

Hey — my former supervisor at FAU OIT is actively looking for students right now.

Position: AV/IT Support Technician
Pay: ~$15/hr | ~20 hrs/week
What you'll do: Help professors with PC issues, make sure AV equipment is set up and ready for class every day — solid hands-on IT experience with a flexible, chill team.

To apply, email your resume to:
📧 glen@fau.edu
📧 jrukes@fau.edu

In your subject line or email body, mention you're from the FAU Cybersecurity Club or that Shaamad referred you — it'll help them place you right away.

Great first role if you're looking to get your foot in the door. Don't sleep on this one 👀
